name: Two Truths and a Lie
description: Each player shares three statements. The class guesses which one is the lie!

intro.message:
Two Truths and a Lie!

You'll write three statements about yourself. Two are true, one is a lie. Then everyone guesses which is the lie!

collect-statements.prompt:
Write your THREE statements separated by slashes (/). Two truths and one lie!

Example: I can juggle / I've been to Japan / I have a pet snake

who-was-it.message:
Those statements were from {{_current.playerName}}!

Ask them: which was the lie?

finale.message: That's everyone! Great job getting to know each other.

end.message: Thanks for playing Two Truths and a Lie!
